metricDefinitions.installed: Participation denominator; available only when electorate, reported attendance, abstention and uninstalled-section voters reconcile.
metricDefinitions.null_total: Distinct official QT_TOTAL_VOTOS_NULOS quantity; retained without assuming equivalence with ordinary null votes.
metricDefinitions.null_technical: Reported QT_VOTOS_NULOS_TECNICOS; distinct technical null votes.
metricDefinitions.annulled: QT_TOTAL_VOTOS_ANULADOS: votes annulled due to the legal status of candidacies or parties.
metricDefinitions.annulled_subjudice: QT_TOTAL_VOTOS_ANUL_SUBJUD: annulled votes under judicial appeal.
metricDefinitions.annulled_separate: QT_VOTOS_ANULADOS_APU_SEP/QTD_VOTOS_ANULADOS_APU_SEP: separately counted votes from urns under judicial review; neither valid nor null pending judgment.
metricDefinitions.valid: Native official JSON v.vv, or QT_TOTAL_VOTOS_VALIDOS only when consistent with nominal and list components; historical votos líquidos are not silently converted.
